text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 8::Three years.
]


For the price of food or drink sold by the keeper of a hotel, tavern or lodging-house.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the food or drink is delivered.
